scope: Independent source/nominal review of public task inputs, fourteen examples and the connected new account. This is not the later independent task-solving review.

records.finding: Nominal case checked: cuman genitive dependent, suna dative recipient, męte accusative thing. Source class and actual prior sunu records support every selected noun form.
Mętes is exact prior genitive singular; mē must be separately governed as dative person. Verb government awaits independent grammar evidence.
Scēapa is genitive plural of heavy neuter scēap; no -as plural. Fela construction is grammar-owned.
Munuca is the actual prior selected genitive plural, not a guessed muneca. Hūse is the prior dative singular; ān receives explicit new partitive use.
Fiscere nominative subject and cuman dative recipient fit actual productive helpan government; weak cuman is not automatically accusative from its shape.
Gāt feminine nominative; scēaphierde masculine dative; behēfu is the actual feminine predicate form. Earlier bare hierde/behēfe provisional inputs were repaired before acceptance.
Ðis and gōd are neuter nominative in the selected nominal seeming construction; mē is the independently supported dative experiencer. No unassigned finite content clause is inferred.
Hine is the actual masculine accusative form, distinct from nominative hē. Impersonal government and finite agreement are grammar-owned.
Mid governs dative cuman; accompanies is the already taught Unit9 use.
Cuman accusative after feeding; gōdum męte dative means after mid. Męte by itself is case-syncretic; adjective/preposition provide the construction.
Cuman accusative; gōde is the distinct masculine singular instrumental strong adjective. Actual noun męte has the dative-shaped ending; this requires explicit instrumental promotion.
Ðȳ is the separate instrumental determiner, not a replacement spelling of dative ðǣm. Noun shape alone does not identify the case.
Cuman and untrumne are masculine accusative singular; the descriptive predicate agrees with the perceived person. The construction must be assigned separately from prior gewyrcean object predicates.
Hungrigan is a weak plural personal substantive in accusative position; singular command address does not force a singular object.

composition_assessment: The 50-word account is coherent. Cuma/cuman refer to the stranger; the monk is one of the stated monks. The stranger receives food and water, contrasts denial, and eats/drinks. Noun case and adjective forms are recoverable from actual prior/new records. New verbal government, nominal partitive and instrumental syntax need the grammar audit’s explicit teaching.

findings.issue: Bare hierde was not the selected Cook shepherd lexeme.
Useful predicate after feminine gāt must follow feminine agreement.
findings.resolution: Design independently repaired to actual behēfu.

findings.issue: Prior selected munuc uses genitive plural munuca.
findings.resolution: Design independently repaired all provisional muneca to munuca.

findings.issue: F02 asks every cell represented by gǣt while selected genitive singular is gāte and accepted variant gǣt is noted.
findings.resolution: F02 now explicitly asks about the selected paradigm; documented genitive singular variant gǣt remains valid language but is outside that selected-cell target.

findings.issue: Right-side hand expression cannot be explained only by directional placement.
findings.resolution: Source p134line8 repeats on his swīðran hand with static standað; bounded side-expression case is explicit in revised support.

remaining_limits: No claim that source nominal review certifies new verb paradigms; grammar agent owns those evidence checks.
No source-only reading construction becomes an unaided production requirement.
